bio: Once an historic watermill, built around 1830, Cambridge Quy Mill is a secluded haven which offers charming hotel accommodation in Cambridge, superb food and unfailing courtesy. The Cambridge Quy Mill is located just 4 miles outside of Cambridge city centre.  Set in the heart of the Cambridgeshire countryside, the newly refurbished Garden Restaurant & Terrace is situated within the Quy Mill hotel. Offering views out onto the perfectly preened lawns, guests can enjoy the dining room's fabulously decorated tea room during winter and dine out on the al fresco terrace in warmer weather.  Cambridge Quy Mill offer a seasonal Afternoon Tea, with the menu changing to reflect the seasons.
